lifecycleGaps: AgentLauncher.launch() only generates a CommandConfig but never spawns the actual CLI process; the real spawn happens elsewhere (presumably in the Tauri Rust backend). If the spawn fails after launch() returns, the session remains in activeSessions forever with no timeout or cleanup.

No lifecycle states for 'pending' or 'awaiting-review' in the AgentLauncher or agentsStore. The orchestrator emits 'awaiting-review' and 'merged'/'failed', but the store only tracks 'launching' | 'running' | 'idle' | 'error' | 'done'.
endSession() is never called inside launch() or any automatic lifecycle hook. There is no session timeout, no heartbeat check, no maximum duration.
The 'done' status in agentsStore is never transitioned to by any code path in the analyzed files.
No event/callback system for status transitions.
AgentRegistry in swarmmind/src/registry is an in-memory Map with no persistence. All agent records, locks, and handoff state are lost on app restart.
processManagementIssues: AgentLauncher never kills or reaps CLI processes. The adapter interface has no kill/cleanup method.
spawnGuard.ts only tracks paneId to directory mapping in a frontend-side Map with no visibility into actual process PIDs, exit codes, or memory usage.
No per-session resource limits (wall-clock timeout, memory cap, output buffer cap).
spawned Map in spawnGuard.ts is never cleaned up for panes that close without calling forgetSpawn.
The Rust-side kill_terminal call swallows all errors, so failed kills silently leave orphaned processes.
securityConcerns: permissionBypassArgs() ships '--dangerously-skip-permissions' (claude), '--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox' (codex), and '--yolo' (cline) by default with no user consent check.
withPermissionBypass() prepends bypass flags before any user-supplied args with no override mechanism.
injectionText (Pheromone context chunks) is injected directly into CLI args with no sanitization or escaping.
No working directory (cwd) validation or sandboxing.
API keys are passed as environment variables to spawned processes with no mechanism to scrub them after process exit.
No content security policy on context injection. formatContext() methods do not escape special characters.
loadClaudeCodeOAuthToken() reads a stored OAuth token and forwards it to the spawned process.
worktree creation uses git commands constructed from user-provided task IDs as branch names without validation.

inconsistent: 8 of 10 adapters share nearly identical getCommand() implementations. Only Aider differs, suggesting copy-paste maintenance risk.
All 10 adapters share identical onSessionEnd() logic duplicated 10 times instead of a base class.
Aider combines context and task into a single --message arg while all others pass them as separate args.
No adapter exposes a working directory argument. CommandConfig has no cwd field.
Adapters do not participate in permissionBypass -- applied separately via withPermissionBypass() in cli-configs.
missing: No adapter handles --model flag for model selection despite model-catalog.ts existing.
No adapter handles resume/attach flags for PTY respawns.
No adapter exposes MCP server configuration for 8 of 10 CLIs.
No adapter handles timeout, max-turns, or budget limits.
KimiCodeAdapter, KiloAdapter, CursorAdapter, KiroAdapter have no permission bypass args defined.

issues: spawnGuard.ts is purely frontend-side state. A page refresh or React StrictMode double-mount clears all spawn tracking.
The Rust side's is_process_alive check is the only verification of process liveness; errors are treated as 'dead', causing unnecessary respawns.
The guard does not prevent spawning a second process for the same paneId in a different directory if markSpawned is not called first.
Transcript storage has no encryption or access control.

recommendations: Add a base AgentAdapter class with shared onSessionEnd logic to eliminate 10x duplication.
Integrate the model catalog into adapters: inject --model flags when the agent is launched with a pinned model.
Implement process cleanup in the adapter interface -- add a kill() method and track PIDs.
Persist AgentRegistry state to disk so agent records survive app restarts.
Add a session timeout/heartbeat mechanism to auto-terminate idle agents.
Align the two state machines: map agentsStore statuses to orchestrator statuses.
Validate taskId/branchName before passing to git with a whitelist pattern.
Add a user-facing consent step before applying permissionBypass flags.
Encrypt transcripts at rest or clear them on process exit.
Add MCP config support for all 10 CLIs.
Implement resume/attach flags in adapters for CLIs that support them.
Add a working directory (cwd) field to CommandConfig.
